findings.title: Identifiable dataset
findings.description: Stored records contain combined demographic, operational, or location attributes that allow re-identification.
findings.mitigation: Apply l-diversity, t-closeness, or noise injection to stored analytical tables.

findings.title: Unnecessary data retention
findings.description: Data is persisted indefinitely without time-to-live expiration or scheduled pruning procedures.
findings.mitigation: Implement automated cron jobs or database retention TTLs to delete stale records.

findings.title: Insufficient access
findings.description: Data subjects cannot retrieve, view, or export the personal records collected and stored about them.
findings.mitigation: Expose self-service data export APIs or standardized take-out archives.

findings.component_name: Envio de Login e Dados de Saúde
findings.title: Detectable service usage
findings.description: Unencrypted or observable transmission endpoints allow network observers to detect interaction with the service.
findings.mitigation: Enforce strict TLS encryption, DNS-over-HTTPS, and mask server endpoint semantics.

findings.title: Identified user requests
findings.description: Incoming user requests contain explicit identity data (e.g. full name, email, credentials).
findings.mitigation: Avoid requesting direct identity data when pseudonymous authentication or zero-knowledge proofs suffice.
